sampling_rate.consequence_note: 4Hz (250ms) cannot resolve a single ~0.4-0.95ms inference (roughly 260-2400x coarser). Per-inference energy is ALWAYS derived from sustained-loop average power and concurrent throughput, never from a single-shot measurement.
